label: List what is kept
description: Data graph behind customer.listAll under the local profile: every record of the customers collection. A find with no filter answers the whole collection, which is what a small one is for. The same graph as @customers/data/kept-list.graph.json, against the store kept in PostgreSQL: a store is named statically at a call site, so pointing these at another connection is a copy until a profile may swap one.
